# telnyx_agent_gateway_policy_attachment (Resource)

Where an Agent Gateway applies a policy. It has no update, so every change replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Apply the policy to the requests for the listed models only. Every change
# replaces the attachment.
resource "telnyx_agent_gateway_policy_attachment" "cheap_models" {
  gateway_id = telnyx_agent_gateway.example.id
  policy     = telnyx_agent_gateway_policy.default.name
  models     = ["gpt-4o-mini", "claude-*"]
  priority   = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.
- `policy` (String) The policy to apply, by name.

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) `true` applies the policy only to the requests no other attachment matches.
- `models` (Set of String) The models whose requests the policy applies to, by name. A name can use `*` as a wildcard. Empty applies the policy to every request.
- `priority` (Number) An attachment with a priority applies before the others.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the attachment was created.
- `id` (String) The attachment's ID.
- `updated_at` (String) When the attachment last changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_agent_gateway_policy_attachment.cheap_models <gateway_id>/<id>
```
